title: Homilies on Jeremiah, Homilies 1–2
blurb: Origen on Jeremiah. Twenty Greek homilies survive; this page has Homilies 1–2 (Jeremiah 1:2–10 and 2:21–22). The rest of the volume is still being translated.
first_english_note: These Greek homilies had no earlier complete English a reader could freely use. This page is Homilies 1–2 only. The English here is new.
